svg.title: A countermodel of ¬(∀x. p(x)) ⊢ ∃x. ¬p(x)
svg.desc: A Kripke model of 2 worlds with growing domains. An arrow points from a world to a world above it, which has every element of the world below and forces everything it forces. World 0, the model's world, has the element 0, and forces nothing; world 1 is above it. World 1 has the elements 0 and 1, and forces p(0). World 0 forces each formula left of ⊢ and not the one right of it, so ¬(∀x. p(x)) ⊢ ∃x. ¬p(x) is not valid in intuitionistic logic.
